commit.message:
Fixing two more cases that can provole deopt storm:
1. Parse::create_jump_tables
-> too_many_traps(_or_recompiles)
-> jump_if_true_fork/jump_if_always_fork -> GraphKit::uncommon_trap: Action_reinterpret=>Action_none

2. PhaseStringOpts::PhaseStringOpts
-> build_candidate -> validate_control_flow -> too_many_traps_or_recompiles
-> replace_string_concat -> GraphKit::uncommon_trap: Action_maybe_recompile=>Action_none
Align uncommon-trap guards with recompilation cutoffs: replace too_many_traps() with too_many_traps_or_recompiles() at other susceptible sites
using too_many_traps_or_recompiles. adding DeoptStorm jtreg test
8374307: Fix deoptimization storm caused by Action_none in GraphKit::uncommon_trap
